_comment: Realistic happy-path disclosure case for the vuln_intake worked example. Drives the cross-target replay test under tests/examples/vuln_intake/test_happy_path.py. LM-touching steps would consume the deterministic-stub adapter (see docs/FOUNDATION.md §Determinism); this fixture exercises the CORE-bound steps only (intake dedup + triage severity policy), which are pure deterministic primitives.
